data.name: Kunalraj
data.gender_notes: Kunalraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kunalraj is a combination of two words - Kunal (Lord Krishna's name) and Raja (meaning king or ruler). This name signifies the divine power of Lord Krishna, the god of love, wisdom, and strength in Hindu mythology. The name Kunalraj carries the meaning “Lord Krishna's Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kunalraj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord krishna's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Kunalraj signifies the powerful presence and might of Lord Krishna within an individual. The name invokes the qualities of Lord Krishna as a divine spiritual guide, a wise mentor, and a loving protector. historical_references.reference: The name Kunalraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'kunala' meaning 'little one' and 'raj' meaning 'king'. It is believed that this name was used for royal children who were considered as future rulers, and were given the title 'king' even in their infancy.

Another reference suggests that Kunalraj was the name of a famous king who ruled over the region of Malwa in Central India around the 12th century AD. He is known for his military conquests and is considered a powerful and just ruler in Hindu mythology.
